title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang’s ties with China

claims.claim: California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced that the state has served an investigative subpoena to Nvidia.

evidence.quote: California’s Attorney General Rob Bonta on Thursday evening said the state has served an investigative subpoena to Nvidia following news of former CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman who the U.S. government believes is a Chinese spy.

claims.claim: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang resigned last week following revelations of extramarital affairs.

evidence.quote: The Nvidia founder resigned last week after further revelations of extramarital affairs with the company’s employees.
Jensen Huang was ousted from Nvidia amid allegations of extramarital affairs, including a relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

claims.claim: Nvidia's new chair Harvey Jones stated earlier this week that the company had no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang to his position.

evidence.quote: the company’s new chair, Harvey Jones, said earlier this week that Nvidia had no intention of reinstating Huang to his position.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.

evidence.quote: Huang has agreed to testify before Congress after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.

claims.claim: The U.S. government is investigating whether Alice Huang has ties with the Chinese government.

evidence.quote: the U.S. government is trying to find out the extent of Alice Huang’s ties with the Chinese government.

claims.claim: Democratic representatives opened an inquiry into the Trump administration's management of Nvidia's chip sales to China.

evidence.quote: Democratic representatives have also opened an inquiry into the Trump administration’s management of Nvidia’s chip sales to China.
